en.title: Network Formation
en.description:
Form networks from several non-overlapping contiguous ranges of computers, in the original order. Each network must contain at least minComps computers and have a total speed of at least speedThreshold; computers not used in any network may be skipped. Find the maximum number of networks. Speeds are non-negative integers.

See the statement/review record for the problem source and the basis of the rules; limits marked in the input ranges are supplements added by this site.
en.input: The first line contains n, minComps and speedThreshold; the second line contains n non-negative integers speed[i]. Site ranges: 1≤n≤200000, 1≤minComps≤n, 0≤speed[i]≤10^9, 0≤speedThreshold≤10^14.
en.output: Output the maximum number of networks that can be formed.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the problem rules; see the companion notes for the full approach, the correctness argument and the complexity.
hints: Accumulate the not-yet-used computers from left to right; as soon as the current contiguous segment first meets both the length and the speed requirement, take it as a network right away and keep scanning.
